name: Creuddylad
text: Creuddylad and Creudylad are Welsh spellings of Creiddylad. MacKillop lists both forms at one short entry. Creiddylad is the maiden for whom Gwyn ap Nudd and Gwythyr fab Greidawl fight each May Day. Readers should follow the Creiddylad entry for the story and the seasonal battle.

attributes.attribute: further Welsh form of the same name
maiden fought over each May Day by Gwyn and Gwythyr

okr.objective: Route the Creuddylad and Creudylad spellings to Creiddylad.
key_results: MacKillop gives Creuddylad and Creudylad as Welsh spellings of Creiddylad.
